"
Centrolene
"
robledoi"
is a species of
frog
in the family
Centrolenidae
. It is
endemic
to Colombia.
Its natural
habitats
are subtropical or tropical moist lowland
forests
, subtropical or tropical moist
montane forests
, and
rivers
. It is threatened by
habitat loss
.
The frog's range includes at least one protected park, including the
Ranita Dorada Amphibian Reserve
.
